# Security Policy — popclozet

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

- **Email:** security@popclozet.com
- **Response time:** We aim to respond within 48 hours.
- **Do NOT** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest  | ✅        |
| Older   | ❌        |

## Scope

- Customer App (apps/customer-app)
- Rider App (apps/rider-app)
- Supabase backend (RLS, RPC functions, Edge Functions)
- API integrations (Mapbox, Payment providers)

## Out of Scope

- Social engineering attacks
- Denial of service attacks
- Issues in third-party services (Supabase infrastructure, Cloudflare, etc.)
